datasets.dataset_name: Historical Annual Average Daily Traffic Volume - 2019
datasets.publisher: Victorian Department of Transport and Planning
datasets.processing_required: Validate coordinates; clip and intersect with SA2; calculate length-weighted AADT and high-volume-road length within a pre-registered residential exposure buffer.
datasets.sa2_aedc_compatibility: spatial overlay required; temporal gap to AEDC 2024
datasets.coverage: Victoria declared-road network; excludes local-road traffic
datasets.limitations: Observed or estimated values are mixed. The newest historical bulk layer is 2019 and does not represent all roads or personal exposure.
datasets.health_relevance: Traffic-related air and safety exposure proxy
datasets.feature_enabled: validated SA2/AEDC context contract; backend not enabled

datasets.dataset_name: National Register - Education and Care Services (Victoria)
datasets.publisher: Australian Children's Education and Care Quality Authority
datasets.licence: Public register; reuse terms require confirmation before product publication
datasets.processing_required: Linked to Vicmap child-care points only through exact service approval numbers; exclude temporary closures from active counts; retain unmatched records as unresolved.
datasets.sa2_aedc_compatibility: 96.23% exact statewide authority-ID match to Vicmap coordinates; point-in-polygon to Edition 3 SA2 completed
datasets.coverage: 5,016 Victorian approved services in acquired snapshot
datasets.limitations: Approved places are not vacancies. Rating dates vary. Address geocoding may introduce error. No claim of access, affordability or suitability is supported.
datasets.health_relevance: Early-years service availability and quality context
datasets.feature_enabled: validated SA2/AEDC context contract; backend not enabled

datasets.dataset_name: Vicmap Features of Interest - selected point features
datasets.processing_required: Filter VIC and Greater Melbourne; exact identifier linkage for child care; category-specific deduplication and accessibility measures for remaining facilities.
datasets.sa2_aedc_compatibility: point-in-polygon to Edition 3 SA2; exact ACECQA authority-ID linkage available for child care
datasets.coverage: 13,657 selected features downloaded nationally/state-border vicinity; 5,084 VIC-labelled child-care points
datasets.limitations: Feature currency varies by authority. A point does not establish service availability, capacity, affordability or travel time.
datasets.health_relevance: Coordinate backbone for early childhood, MCH, hospitals and active-living facilities
datasets.feature_enabled: early-childhood SA2/AEDC context contract only; backend not enabled

datasets.publisher: Australian Government Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water
datasets.licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia (verify against current dataset metadata before publication)
datasets.spatial_resolution: Point facility by substance and report year
datasets.processing_required: Filter latest complete year and Victoria; validate coordinates and pollutant units; aggregate duplicate facility-substance reports; calculate distance/buffer indicators without treating reported mass as ambient exposure.
datasets.coverage: 191,416 Victorian facility-substance-year rows across 1,605 facilities in acquired workbook
datasets.limitations: NPI thresholds omit smaller facilities. Emitted mass is not ambient concentration or individual exposure. Air-total emission is missing in 8.35% of Victorian rows across all years.
datasets.feature_enabled: validated SA2/AEDC context contract; backend not enabled

datasets.dataset_name: VIF2023 SA2 Population Age and Sex Projections to 2036 Release 2
datasets.publisher: Victorian Department of Transport and Planning
datasets.processing_required: Complete: filtered 522 unique SA2 records, reshaped four years and three sex categories, retained 0-4 and 5-9 bands, and labelled every value PROJECTED.
datasets.sa2_aedc_compatibility: direct verified Edition 3 SA2 join; all 522 Victorian SA2 codes present
datasets.coverage: All 522 Victorian SA2s; 2021, 2026, 2031 and 2036; male, female and persons; five-year age bands
datasets.limitations: Projections are conditional estimates, not predictions. Uncertainty increases for smaller areas and longer horizons. Exact ages 0-5 cannot be derived from the published 0-4 and 5-9 bands without an additional estimation assumption.
datasets.health_relevance: Future pressure on early-years and healthcare services
datasets.feature_enabled: validated SA2 context contract; backend not enabled

datasets.dataset_name: EPA AirWatch all sites air quality hourly averages - yearly
datasets.processing_required: Complete: harmonised schemas, retained only Y flags where available, separated methods/station series, removed exact duplicates, excluded conflicting station-hours, produced station/day and station/year summaries.
datasets.sa2_aedc_compatibility: insufficient for locality exposure; no nearest-monitor assignment or SA2 interpolation performed
datasets.coverage: 2018-2025; 21 named stations; 2,009,792 accepted hourly values across four priority pollutants
datasets.limitations: Sparse and changing station network; methods and IDs change; 2018-2020 lack row validation flags; campaign and compliance contexts differ; station readings are not SA2-wide or personal exposure.
datasets.health_relevance: Observed ambient respiratory-environment context at monitor locations
datasets.feature_enabled: station-level research tables only; air quality remains unavailable for user-facing locality interpretation

datasets.processing_required: Complete API access setup; retain station/method/quality flags; build daily pollutant summaries; assess station coverage before any interpolation.
datasets.sa2_aedc_compatibility: stations cannot be assigned as SA2-wide exposure without a validated model
datasets.coverage: monitoring stations across Victoria; exact historical coverage requires API access
datasets.limitations: Real-time station readings do not provide a validated small-area historical exposure surface. Instrument adjustments and outages must be retained.
datasets.health_relevance: PM2.5, PM10, NO2 and ozone respiratory context where actually observed

datasets.processing_required: Validate open status and coordinates; point-in-polygon join to SA2; do not substitute schools for early-childhood services.
datasets.coverage: 2,301 Victorian school records in acquired snapshot
datasets.limitations: Not an early-childhood, capacity, enrolment or quality dataset. Included only as future child-services context.

datasets.dataset_name: Geoscape Geocoded National Address File (G-NAF), August 2026 GDA2020
datasets.licence: Open G-NAF EULA; dataset metadata CC BY 4.0
datasets.geography: Australian physical addresses; Victorian subset used
datasets.processing_required: Complete initial conservative pass: streamed Victorian address/geocode tables, deterministic full/base-address matching, rejected ambiguity and weak geocode types, then point-in-polygon joined accepted points to Edition 3 SA2.
datasets.sa2_aedc_compatibility: GDA2020 points spatially joined to ASGS Edition 3 SA2 boundaries
datasets.coverage: 3,314 of 5,016 ACECQA services matched exactly/high-confidence; 2,450 accepted matches fall inside Greater Melbourne reporting SA2s
datasets.limitations: Default geocode quality varies. Address-source differences create unmatched and ambiguous records. Locality/street centroids cannot represent precise service locations.
datasets.health_relevance: Authoritative coordinate source for ACECQA service context
datasets.feature_enabled: validated geocoding QA layer; downstream ACECQA replacement pending comparative review

datasets.dataset_name: Social Health Atlas of Australia - Health status by Population Health Area
datasets.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 Australia; non-commercial use with attribution and share-alike
datasets.geography: Population Health Area built from ASGS Edition 3 SA2s
datasets.spatial_resolution: PHA; 276 Victorian PHAs composed from 522 Victorian SA2s
variables: child overweight and obesity modelled estimates
datasets.access_method: public workbook; user supplied official snapshot
datasets.processing_required: Retain suppression and model-quality fields; aggregate SA2 environmental covariates to PHA before analysis; never disaggregate a PHA outcome to SA2.
datasets.sa2_aedc_compatibility: many-to-one SA2-to-PHA concordance supplied; analysis must occur at PHA or higher
datasets.coverage: All 522 Victorian SA2s allocated to 276 PHAs; 12 selected child and maternal indicators
datasets.limitations: Ecological aggregate data. Census conditions are self-reported; overweight/obesity values are modelled estimates; periods differ by indicator; suppressed values are excluded. Licence is non-commercial and share-alike.
datasets.health_relevance: Aggregate child respiratory, health, prevention and early-life outcome context
datasets.feature_enabled: validated research context only; user-facing interpretation disabled

datasets.dataset_name: Linked child hospitalisation and emergency presentation outcomes at SA2
datasets.licence: restricted health data; project approval required
datasets.geography: smallest public child-specific geography not established; public products commonly aggregate to LGA or larger
datasets.spatial_resolution: not available for legitimate automatic acquisition
datasets.format: restricted unit-record or approved aggregate extract
datasets.access_method: manual data request / ethics and governance approval
datasets.processing_required: Define cohort, denominator, suppression and approved geography in a formal request; ingest only approved aggregates at their published geography.
datasets.sa2_aedc_compatibility: unknown; never disaggregate LGA results to SA2
datasets.limitations: No legitimate public SA2 child-health outcome extract was identified. Missing outcome data must never be interpreted as low risk.
datasets.health_relevance: Direct outcomes, subject to privacy and governance
